preRegistration: Thresholds below were fixed from 2D anatomical reasoning BEFORE any comparison with catalogue caution tags. They are engineering proxies on a single demonstrator's standard video, not clinical measurements.
torsoScale: p75 of shoulder-mid to hip-mid distance over all valid frames of the same video (standing reference; bending frames shorten it)

frameFlags.overhead: either side: wrist above nose (or above shoulder by 0.5 torso when nose hidden) AND elbow above shoulder
frameFlags.bending: vertical torso component (hipMid.y - shoulderMid.y) below 0.6 torso scale, OR nose below shoulder line
frameFlags.balance: ankle height difference above 0.35 torso scale (one foot clearly off the floor); heel raise (提踵) is NOT measurable
frameFlags.weightBearing: either wrist below (ankle.y - 0.15 torso scale), i.e. hand near floor level

regionInvolvement.shoulders: p90-p10 of upper-arm elevation angle (shoulder->elbow vs downward vertical), max of sides, degrees
regionInvolvement.arms: p90-p10 of elbow angle, max of sides, degrees
regionInvolvement.neck: p90-p10 of (ear distance / shoulder width) relative to video median, plus p90-p10 of ear-line tilt in radians
regionInvolvement.trunk: p90-p10 of trunk side lean (degrees/90) + p90-p10 of vertical torso ratio + p90-p10 of |ln width ratio|
regionInvolvement.legs: p90-p10 of knee angle (max of sides, degrees/180) + p90-p10 of hip-mid height / torso scale
regionInvolvement.normalisation: divide by the 90th percentile of the same raw measure over all chapters with reliable data, clip to [0,1]
